commission_journal_accounts_check.name: commission_journal_accounts_check
commission_journal_accounts_check.value:
("commission_journal"."kind" = 'accrual' and "commission_journal"."debit_account" = 'commission_expense' and "commission_journal"."credit_account" = 'available' and "commission_journal"."collection_id" is not null and "commission_journal"."withdrawal_id" is null) or
        ("commission_journal"."kind" = 'reserve' and "commission_journal"."debit_account" = 'available' and "commission_journal"."credit_account" = 'reserved' and "commission_journal"."withdrawal_id" is not null and "commission_journal"."collection_id" is null) or
        ("commission_journal"."kind" = 'release' and "commission_journal"."debit_account" = 'reserved' and "commission_journal"."credit_account" = 'available' and "commission_journal"."withdrawal_id" is not null and "commission_journal"."collection_id" is null) or
        ("commission_journal"."kind" = 'paid' and "commission_journal"."debit_account" = 'reserved' and "commission_journal"."credit_account" = 'external_payment' and "commission_journal"."withdrawal_id" is not null and "commission_journal"."collection_id" is null)

commission_withdrawal_actor_check.name: commission_withdrawal_actor_check
commission_withdrawal_actor_check.value: ("commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_type" = 'ADMIN' and "commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_admin_id" is not null and "commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_agent_user_id" is null) or ("commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_type" = 'AGENT' and "commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_admin_id" is null and "commission_withdrawal_event"."actor_agent_user_id" is not null)

commission_withdrawal_intent_resolution_.name: commission_withdrawal_intent_resolution_check
commission_withdrawal_intent_resolution_.value: "commission_withdrawal_intent"."resolution" is null or ("commission_withdrawal_intent"."resolution" = 'acknowledged' and "commission_withdrawal_intent"."withdrawal_id" is not null) or ("commission_withdrawal_intent"."resolution" = 'cancelled' and "commission_withdrawal_intent"."withdrawal_id" is null)

commission_withdrawal_paid_evidence_chec.name: commission_withdrawal_paid_evidence_check
commission_withdrawal_paid_evidence_chec.value: "commission_withdrawal"."status" <> 'paid' or (length(trim("commission_withdrawal"."reference")) > 0 and length(trim("commission_withdrawal"."evidence")) > 0 and "commission_withdrawal"."reference" is not null and "commission_withdrawal"."evidence" is not null)

radacct_usage_pending_idx.name: radacct_usage_pending_idx
radacct_usage_pending_idx.where:
"radacct"."acctstarttime" is not null and (
                "radacct"."usage_captured_input_octets" is null or
                "radacct"."usage_captured_output_octets" is null or
                "radacct"."acctinputoctets" > "radacct"."usage_captured_input_octets" or
                "radacct"."acctoutputoctets" > "radacct"."usage_captured_output_octets"
            )
